audit_scope: Every Java file in common/fabric/forge on retained branches: GUI constructors, providers, open calls, title calls and transitions.
slot_numbering: Logical source slots; runtime buttonRegions/contentRegion supplies physical display positions. Native storage redirects retain their exact positions and objects.
fallback: Original title, item/control/filler objects, callbacks and logical source positions restored in the same server container, preserving the cursor. Dedicated invisible-paper models apply only to painted controls. Real content stacks remain native. Paged flows retain their initial capacity.
source_only_limitations: Source and API-model tests do not establish production transaction behavior. Server builds and actual rendering are recorded separately in QuasarGUIPatches/docs/VERIFICATION.md
Configured admin-shop pages use arbitrary operator-authored slots: four independent layout families; dynamic individual pages share configured family by default.
Auction, watchlist, advertisements and history use fixed-capacity navigation contexts; transaction handlers remain unchanged.

Plot screens (plot_buy, plot_rent, plot_list, plot_manage) were audited on the read-only Quasar 1.21 checkout; their QuasarGUIPatches title composition and InventoryDebug fixtures are not implemented yet.
